   2. tests/tiffImageTest.cpp: #include "fixtureCheck.hpp"; call requireRealFixture(path) in getTestFilePath before returning (construct path, check, then .string()).

Install git-lfs and run: git -C tests/libtiff-pics lfs pull"; restore the original file, rebuild, ctest → 2/2 pass again. Verify git status clean in both parent and submodule afterwards. #!/bin/bash

source "$(dirname "$0")/shared_cmake_preset.sh" "$1"

git submodule update --init --recursive || echo "warning: could not update submodules" >&2
if git lfs version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  git -C tests/libtiff-pics lfs pull || echo "warning: git lfs pull failed; test fixtures may be unresolved" >&2
else
  echo "warning: git-lfs not found; test fixtures may be unresolved Git LFS pointers (apt install git-lfs). Configure will fail with fixture sanity-check instructions." >&2
fi

echo "Building ${PRESET_NAME}"

cmake --preset "${PRESET_NAME}" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=${INSTALL_DIR} && \
  cmake --build --preset "${PRESET_NAME}" -j
#!/bin/bash
# shared_cmake_preset.sh
# Usage: source shared_cmake_preset.sh [PRESET_NAME]

PRESET_NAME=$1
HOST_OS=$OS$OSTYPE
HOST_TYPE=$HOSTTYPE
HOST_ID="${HOST_OS}-${HOST_TYPE}"
INSTALL_DIR=`pwd`/install

# Convert HOST_ID to lowercase
if ((BASH_VERSINFO[0] < 3))
then
  HOST_ID=$(tr '[:lower:]' '[:upper:]' <<< $HOST_ID)
else
  HOST_ID=${HOST_ID,,}
fi

echo "Host OS: $HOST_OS"
echo "Host Type: $HOST_TYPE"
echo "Host Id: $HOST_ID"

if [[ $1 == "" ]]; then
  case "$HOST_ID" in
    "windows_"*)
      # Windows
      PRESET_NAME="msvc-win64-release"
      ;;
    "darwin"*)
      # Mac OSX
      PRESET_NAME="clang-macos-release"
      ;;
    "linux-"*)
      # Linux
      PRESET_NAME="gcc-linux-release"
      ;;
    *)
      # Default case
      echo "Unsupported OS or architecture"
      exit 1
      ;;
  esac
fi

export PRESET_NAME
export INSTALL_DIR

#!/bin/bash

# Parse --preset argument
PRESET_ARG=""
for ((i=1; i<=$#; i++)); do
    arg="${!i}"
    if [[ "$arg" == "--preset" ]]; then
        next_idx=$((i+1))
        PRESET_ARG="${!next_idx}"
    fi
done

source "$(dirname "$0")/shared_cmake_preset.sh" "$PRESET_ARG"

echo "Installing ${PRESET_NAME}"
cmake --build --preset "${PRESET_NAME}" --target install

# Check for --version argument anywhere in the argument list
VERSION_ARG=false
for ((i=1; i<=$#; i++)); do
	arg="${!i}"
	if [[ "$arg" == "--version" ]]; then
		VERSION_ARG=true
		break
	fi
done

if $VERSION_ARG; then
	TIFF_HEADER="install/include/tiffcraft/TiffImage.hpp"
	if [[ ! -f "$TIFF_HEADER" ]]; then
		echo "Error: $TIFF_HEADER not found. Cannot extract version information."
		exit 1
	fi
	MAJOR_VERSION=$(grep 'constexpr int MAJOR_VERSION' "$TIFF_HEADER" | grep -o '[0-9]\+')
	MINOR_VERSION=$(grep 'constexpr int MINOR_VERSION' "$TIFF_HEADER" | grep -o '[0-9]\+')
	PATCH_VERSION=$(grep 'constexpr int PATCH_VERSION' "$TIFF_HEADER" | grep -o '[0-9]\+')
	VERSION="v${MAJOR_VERSION}.${MINOR_VERSION}.${PATCH_VERSION}"
	echo "Creating tarball tiffcraft-$VERSION.tar.gz"
	tar -czvf "tiffcraft-$VERSION.tar.gz" -C install include
	if command -v zip >/dev/null 2>&1; then
		echo "Creating zip file tiffcraft-$VERSION.zip"
		(cd install && zip -r "../tiffcraft-$VERSION.zip" include)
	else
		echo "zip command not found, skipping zip archive creation."
	fi
fi

#!/bin/bash

source "$(dirname "$0")/shared_cmake_preset.sh" "$1"

echo "Testing ${PRESET_NAME}"

ctest --preset "${PRESET_NAME}" --output-on-failure --rerun-failed

@echo off

IF [%1] == [] (
    set PRESET_NAME=msvc-win64-release
) ELSE (
    set PRESET_NAME=%1
)

echo Building %PRESET_NAME%

cmake --preset %PRESET_NAME%&&cmake --build --preset %PRESET_NAME%

on-going development.

# Building from source

Prerequisites: CMake >= 3.22, a C++20 compiler, git, and git-lfs.

Clone the repository with its submodules:

```sh
git clone --recursive https://github.com/danielm5/tiffcraft.git
```

Existing clones can fetch the fixtures with:

```sh
git submodule update --init --recursive
```

The test fixtures live in the `tests/libtiff-pics` submodule and are stored
in Git LFS. On Debian, install git-lfs with `sudo apt install git-lfs`.
`./build.sh` runs the submodule and LFS steps for you; otherwise pull the
fixtures manually:

```sh
git -C tests/libtiff-pics lfs pull
```

Build (`./build.sh` without arguments auto-picks a preset on Linux, Windows,
and macOS):

```sh
./build.sh
```

Or pass an explicit preset (e.g. `gcc-linux-release`, listed in
`CMakePresets.json`):

```sh
./build.sh gcc-linux-release
```

Run the tests:

```sh
ctest --preset gcc-linux-release --output-on-failure
```

or `./run_test.sh`.

Note: without git-lfs the checkout keeps Git LFS pointer files instead of
real TIFFs, and the tests will fail with "Invalid byte order in TIFF header".
To remedy, run:
